item.title: Game check-ins go out when the chat is busy
item.summary: Murph's evening check-in and its missed-day message now send even if someone texts the group while Murph is writing them.
item.details: Before, any new message in those few seconds cancelled the check-in for the whole day. Murph still leaves out anyone who already said they did it, will do it or won't, and still says nothing once everyone has posted.
